sources.note: Main marketing site. Describes One Medical as membership-based primary care, $99/year for Prime members, 125+ offices, 11,600+ employer partnerships.
ONC mandatory disclosure page. Lists 1Life v1.0 certification, 28 certified criteria, SureScripts as relied-upon software. No CQMs certified.
Technology features page. Describes scheduling, virtual care, prescription management, digital health records, provider messaging, and health reminders.

Technology blog post. Details 1Life ecosystem components: EHR/charting, scheduling, administrative, tasking, messaging platforms, patient portal, and mobile apps. Describes React/GraphQL/OpenSearch stack.
AWS case study. Confirms 1Life is custom-built EHR on AWS, designed for team-based care. Describes unified patient profiles, ML for document processing and record summarization.
FAQ page. Details services including women's health, travel medicine, mental health, pediatrics, lab services, prescriptions, referrals, insurance/billing, and membership.
About page. 90+ NPS, 45% monthly digital engagement, 8,500+ employer partners, 19 major U.S. cities, Iora Health acquisition (47 Medicare offices).
Services listing page. Referenced in search results for chronic care management and specialist coordination features.
Impact by One Medical chronic care program. Team-based chronic condition management with care navigators, coaches, personalized care plans.
iOS app listing. Referenced in search results for patient portal features including scheduling, messaging, lab results, and prescription management.
Virtual care guide. Describes scheduling, messaging, prescription renewals, and Treat-Me-Now on-demand video visits.
AHA article on Amazon acquisition. Notes $3.9B deal, 700,000+ members, 125 offices, hybrid in-person/virtual model.
Healthcare Dive coverage of Amazon closing the One Medical acquisition in February 2023.
Fierce Healthcare on the acquisition. Notes One Medical's founding by Tom Lee in 2007 and growth trajectory.
January 2026 article on Amazon adding Health AI assistant to One Medical, with agentic AI for connecting members to providers, reviewing lab results, managing medications.
October 2024 partnership with Cleveland Clinic for coordinated primary and specialty care.

EHI export overview. Exports include FHIR R4 bundle (JSON) and C-CDA 2.1 (XML) with allergies, care teams, conditions, encounters, immunizations, medications, observations, procedures, and vital signs.
1Life Healthcare corporate page. Lists 1Life as providing proprietary technology platform supporting EHR, scheduling, patient billing, and administrative services.
